_meta.author: Claude (draft written from tasks/<task>/responses.json wizard replies)
_meta.style: 'The user ...' sentences. Keys are the task directory names, which equal the 'Task' values of select_task events (the 'task' field inside each task json differs, e.g. restaurant_book vs restaurant_reserve). family = task prefix (= Scenario.Domains value).
_meta.notes: STAR provides no natural-language task descriptions; these are authored for this project.

apartment_schedule.description: The user wants to book a viewing appointment for an apartment.

apartment_search.description: The user wants to search for apartments by criteria such as bedrooms, price or floor.

bank_balance.description: The user wants to check the balance of their bank account.

bank_fraud_report.description: The user wants to report fraudulent activity on their bank account.

doctor_followup.description: The user wants to retrieve the instructions their doctor gave them at an earlier appointment.

doctor_schedule.description: The user wants to book an appointment with a doctor.

hotel_book.description: The user wants to reserve a stay at a hotel.

hotel_search.description: The user wants to search for hotels by name, location, price or rating.

hotel_service_request.description: The user is staying at a hotel and wants to make a service request for their room.

meeting_schedule.description: The user wants to schedule a meeting with someone.

party_plan.description: The user wants to plan and organise a party at a venue.

party_rsvp.description: The user wants to respond to an invitation to a party and say when they will arrive.

plane_book.description: The user wants to book a specific flight.

plane_search.description: The user wants to search for flights between two cities.

restaurant_book.description: The user wants to reserve a table at a restaurant.

restaurant_search.description: The user wants to search for restaurants by name, location, food type or rating.

ride_book.description: The user wants to book a ride from one place to another.

ride_change.description: The user wants to change an existing ride booking.

ride_status.description: The user wants to know the status of their ride, such as when the driver will arrive.

spaceship_access_codes.description: The user wants to obtain or enter an access code on a spaceship.

spaceship_life_support.description: The user wants help repairing or restoring the life support system of a spaceship.

trip_directions.description: The user wants step-by-step directions for a trip by car, on foot or by public transit.

trivia.description: The user wants to play a trivia quiz.

weather.description: The user wants a weather forecast for a certain day and place.
